import json, subprocess, time, urllib.request

subprocess.run("lsof -ti :8090 | xargs kill -9 2>/dev/null || true", shell=True)
time.sleep(0.5)
p = subprocess.Popen(
    ["./bin/orchestrator", "webui", "--addr", ":8090"],
    cwd="/Users/trainguyen/Documents/work/ai-orchestrator",
    stdout=open("/tmp/orchestrator_8090.log", "w"),
    stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,
    start_new_session=True,
)
for _ in range(25):
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen("http://127.0.0.1:8090/api/dashboard", timeout=2) as r:
            data = json.loads(r.read().decode())
            kern = data.get("active_agent_kernel") or {}
            print(f"LIVE :8090 OK pid={p.pid} kernel_enforced={data.get(\"kernel_enforced\")} total_lessons={kern.get(\"total_lessons\")} matched_lessons={len(kern.get(\"matched_lessons\") or [])} active_hooks={kern.get(\"active_hooks\")}")
            break
    except Exception:
        time.sleep(0.3)
else:
    raise SystemExit("Failed to reach :8090")
